what_implemented: A PURE, INERT design-only contract for registering TWO DISTINCT producer ROLES (stage 4 build-producer registration + stage 5 OCI-inspection-producer registration) of the merged FW-08 real-proof lifecycle (FUT-2, the second future gate), so a build producer and an OCI-inspection producer are STRUCTURALLY separated for later Stage-B.

ProducerRegistrationRecord frozen dataclass (EV-04 build / EV-05 OCI): binds contract_version, lifecycle_stage, registration_id, producer_role, producer/execution/executable identity references, authority_root reference, approval-record reference, activated-registry-handle reference, permitted + forbidden evidence classes, registration/validity UTC, revocation_state, provenance, synthetic_or_real_classification, status, fault_code, evidence references, created_by, a registration_digest and a module-issuer seal. References + status ONLY; no private/secret/endpoint fields.

validate_producer_registration: reject-not-repair validator covering type, an INDEPENDENT real-registration gate (evaluated FIRST), digest tamper, seal forgery/relabel, synthetic-in-real-mode, real-status-forbidden, bad role, evidence-class mismatch, dual-role, evidence-class violation, evidence bound-elsewhere, inline-payload and non-canonical references, missing references/provenance, non-UTC, expiry, revocation, contract version, wrong stage, and authority-not-governed.

evaluate_producer_registration_distinctness: derives distinctness across the six F2-R3 dimensions; DELEGATES execution independence to design.hermes_fw08_execution_identity_v1.evaluate_execution_independence and surfaces its EI-* reasons verbatim (incl. EI-COMMON-EXECUTABLE-AND-AUTHORITY when executable_digest + authority + runner coincide — labels differing is NOT sufficient); adds same-* reference checks and PR-FUT2-ALIASED-IDENTITY for case/whitespace/unicode/proxy-alias collisions.

validate_registration_approval: rejects producer self-approval (incl. alias), an approver sharing execution/executable/authority with the producer (PR-FUT2-APPROVER-NOT-INDEPENDENT), an approval bound to another producer/role/registration (PR-FUT2-APPROVAL-BINDING), and copied/relabelled/expired/revoked approvals; delegates ApprovalRecord digest recompute for tamper detection.

validate_evidence_class: build producer output limited to BUILD_EVIDENCE, OCI to OCI_INSPECTION_EVIDENCE; rejects build-emitting-OCI / OCI-emitting-build (PR-FUT2-EVIDENCE-CLASS-VIOLATION), an OCI producer repackaging the build producer's execution output (PR-FUT2-OCI-REPACKAGES-BUILD), inline-payload and non-canonical class references.

_ModuleRegistrationIssuer (ephemeral in-process HMAC, name-mangled key, no getter), _MODULE_ISSUER singleton, _REGISTRATION_TOKEN module-private sentinel — mirroring FUT-1 _ReadinessIssuer / F2-R1 _ModuleVerifier.

production_producer_registry_configured() (False) and configured_registry_authority_identity() (None) — the module-controlled real-registration root; register_producer(mode=REAL_CANDIDATE) always fails closed; new_synthetic_producer_registration / new_synthetic_registration are token-gated SYNTHETIC-only mints.
eventual_evidence_record_ids() extending the D-PR120-EV-TAIL sequence with EV-04-BUILD-PRODUCER-REGISTRATION + EV-05-OCI-INSPECTION-PRODUCER-REGISTRATION.
what_not_implemented: NO real producer is registered; NO registry is activated; NO image is built or inspected.
NO external verifier integration (that is FUT-7 / stages 17-18); NO evidence store (that is FUT-3 / gate 6); NO Stage-B.
NO keys, secrets, credentials, or signing material are created, stored, or embedded anywhere.
NO runtime is touched; the module is not imported by runtime; no I/O, subprocess, network, filesystem, or environment lookup is performed.
NO configuration values in code — references only.

build_producer_responsibilities.registration: governed ProducerRegistry under a trusted ActivatedRegistryHandle (F2-R1) — inert here; the handle is recorded ONLY as a reference and no real handle is activated.

distinctness.assertion: build producer and OCI producer MUST be distinct across all six dimensions (execution identity, registration, runner, executable boundary, evidence reference, provenance); identity is keyed on executable_digest + authority_reference + runner_identity, NOT on tool/producer names.
distinctness.ei_common_executable_and_authority: surfaced when build and OCI executions share executable_digest + authority_reference + runner_identity
distinctness.labels_insufficient: differing producer ids / tool names alone do NOT establish distinctness — EI-COMMON-EXECUTABLE-AND-AUTHORITY still fires

registry_and_activated_handle_authority.note: A real producer registration's authority is conferred ONLY by resolution through a governed ActivatedRegistryHandle (F2-R1 §10/§11). In this inert WO the handle is a REFERENCE only; the decisive real-registration root is the module-controlled configured_registry_authority_identity() which is None.
registry_and_activated_handle_authority.authority_not_governed: a real record deriving authority only from the local seal / a raw registry / an unactivated handle / a caller assertion -> PR-FUT2-AUTHORITY-NOT-GOVERNED
registry_and_activated_handle_authority.registry_authority_not_configured: a real record cannot resolve the module-controlled configured registry authority (None) -> PR-FUT2-REGISTRY-AUTHORITY-NOT-CONFIGURED

evidence_class_separation.oci_repackages_build: OCI evidence produced FROM the build producer's execution -> PR-FUT2-OCI-REPACKAGES-BUILD

production_unavailability.decisive_root: C-FUT2-REGISTRY-SOLE-ROOT: validate_producer_registration's real-registration gate runs FIRST and requires production_producer_registry_configured()==True AND the record to resolve the module-controlled configured_registry_authority_identity() (None here). The identity is a NON-Boolean second anchor so the Boolean can NEVER become the sole root: even with production_producer_registry_configured monkeypatched True, the configured identity is None -> PR-FUT2-REGISTRY-AUTHORITY-NOT-CONFIGURED -> no real record validates. A caller cannot supply this identity (not via the handle reference, not reflectively).
production_unavailability.local_seal_is_integrity_metadata_only: the _MODULE_ISSUER HMAC (registration_seal) is LOCAL OBJECT-INTEGRITY METADATA ONLY — NOT a production trust root, NOT registry authority, NOT external attestation, and NEVER by itself grounds real-mode acceptance. A reflectively-reachable in-process key can mint a valid seal, so a valid local seal must NEVER by itself cause acceptance.

synthetic_real_boundary.classification_setter: C-FUT2-REGISTRATION-PROMOTION: the token-gated mint (new_synthetic_producer_registration / register_producer) is SYNTHETIC-ONLY and REJECTS any caller-selected non-synthetic classification with ProducerRegistrationForbidden (not silently repaired). A real classification can only ever arise from a genuinely-available governed production registry (unavailable in this WO), never from caller-supplied construction.
synthetic_real_boundary.seal_binds_classification: the module seal covers registration_digest + classification, so a relabel synthetic->'REAL' breaks the seal (PR-FUT2-SEAL-INVALID)

prohibited_interpretations: This contract does NOT mean a real producer is registered or a registry is activated.
SYNTHETIC_UNREGISTERED minted here is test-only; it never certifies a real registration.
The module seal is NOT registry authority; it is an ephemeral in-process integrity seal.
No output of this contract authorises execution, publication, deployment, image build/inspection, or any runtime change.
acceptance_tests: DECISIVE: a reflectively-forged, correctly-sealed REAL registration validated in real_mode with production_producer_registry_configured monkeypatched True is STILL rejected PR-FUT2-REGISTRY-AUTHORITY-NOT-CONFIGURED (Boolean not sole root, seal not sole root); configured_registry_authority_identity() is None.
Synthetic build + OCI registrations accepted only in TEST_ONLY; the SAME under REAL_CANDIDATE rejected.

Synthetic passed as real (real_mode) -> PR-FUT2-SYNTHETIC-IN-REAL-MODE; caller-created / copied / relabelled / dataclasses.replace / object.__new__ / subclass / vars-mutation / reflective-issuer records rejected.
Self-approval and shared-execution/executable/authority/alias approver -> PR-FUT2-SELF-APPROVAL / PR-FUT2-APPROVER-NOT-INDEPENDENT; approval copied/role-mismatch/expired/revoked rejected.

Distinctness: same producer/execution/executable/authority/registration-id; alias canonical-same -> PR-FUT2-ALIASED-IDENTITY; common executable+authority+runner -> EI-COMMON-EXECUTABLE-AND-AUTHORITY; dual-role; one-execution-both-roles.
Evidence separation: build emits OCI / OCI emits build / OCI repackages build execution -> PR-FUT2-OCI-REPACKAGES-BUILD; wrong-class; bound-elsewhere; inline; traversal/encoding on refs.
Inertness: module performs no open()/os.environ/getenv/socket/subprocess/requests/urllib/Path and no import-time I/O; secret-scan module + JSON + MD.
Positive: a fully-distinct synthetic build + OCI pair validates in TEST_ONLY and the SAME under REAL_CANDIDATE rejects.
